content:
# The Ledger of Empty Chairs — Tamper-Evident Log Specification

## 1. Object under test

Five Chairs sit in the Hall. Time advances in **vespers** (fixed ticks). At each vespers, whoever sits signs a **head**; a missed vespers is an **Empty Chair** — the world's name for its own primary failure signal.

**Placard (ledger entry) `P_k`:**

| field | size |
|---|---|
| `seq` | u64 |
| `prev_root` r_{k−1} | 32 B |
| `payload` | variable |
| `t` (tick) | u32 |
| `signer_id` | u8 |
| Ed25519 sig over all above | 64 B |

**Head `H_k`:** `(seq, root r_k, t, sigs)` — accepted iff **≥3-of-5** distinct Chair keys sign `(seq ‖ r_k ‖ t)`.

**Hashing (RFC 6962 style, domain-separated):**
- Leaf: `L_k = H(0x00 ‖ seq_k ‖ payload_k ‖ prev_root ‖ t)`
- Node: `N = H(0x01 ‖ left ‖ right)`, unbalanced right-promotion
- Genesis: `r_0 = H("GENESIS ‖ world_seed")`; Chair roster is itself a genesis payload entry, so trust anchors are internal.

Every placard literally *speaks the name of the last root*: `prev_root = r_{k−1}`. This single constraint is what makes everything below measurable.

## 2. Why measurement works — Monotone Divergence Lemma

> **Lemma.** If two histories agree on `h_i` but differ on `h_{i}`, they differ on **every** index `j > i`.
>
> *Proof:* `r_{j−1}` is a pure function of `h_{≤ j−1}`. Divergence at `i` forces `r_i ≠ r'_i`, hence `prev_root` differs in `P_{i+1}`, hence `h_{i+1} ≠ h'_{i+1}`; induct forward. ∎

Consequence: the set of differing indices between any two claimed histories is a **suffix** `{f, f+1, …}`. Divergence has a well-defined first point `f`, findable by binary search. Nothing is guessed; the fork index is *read off the data*.

## 3. Measured signals

All four are computable by any client holding public heads + audit proofs. No trust in the Hall required.

| # | Signal | Definition | Honest baseline |
|---|---|---|---|
| **S1** | Continuity residual `ρ_k` | `[ recompute(r_k from L_k path) ≠ r_k ]`, or `P_k.prev_root ≠ r_{k−1}` | exactly **0** for all k — deterministic |
| **S2** | Fork index `f(A,B)` | `min{ i : h_i^A ≠ h_i^B }` by binary search (⌈log₂ n⌉ probes) using §2 | undefined (no forks) |
| **S3** | Empty-Chair run | `E_t = 1` iff no valid head at vespers t **or** some published placard lacks an inclusion proof within `d = 3` vespers; measure run lengths of `E = 1` | run length ≤ 5 (derived below) |
| **S4** | Seq monotonicity | heads per signer epoch must have strictly increasing `seq` | always holds |

**Calibration (this is where "measured" comes from):** observe `n₀ = 100,000` vespers under known-honest operation. Per-tick attendance probability `q̂ = attended / n₀`. Take the lower 95% confidence bound `q_L = q̂ − 1.96·√(q̂(1−q̂)/n₀)`. Also record the empirical run-length distribution; if it deviates >2 SE from the Bernoulli model, substitute the empirical quantile for `q_L`.

## 4. Closed-form decision rules

### 4a. Tamper verdict (deterministic — no statistics, no suspicion)

```
TAMPERED(H)  ⇔  (∃ k ≤ n : ρ_k = 1)                                  -- forged/mutated entry
             ∨  (∃ i < j : VerifyInclusion(x, rᵢ) ∧ VerifyInclusion(x, rⱼ)
                        ∧ ¬VerifyConsistency(i, j))                   -- split view
             ∨  (any accepted head does not extend the offline-pinned root)   -- R0 pin
             ∨  (S4 violation)
```

A tamper verdict is a **failed proof**, not a judgment call. It is emitted with the exact failing index attached.

### 4b. Liveness verdict (the Empty-Chair rule)

Event of interest: a run of `m` consecutive empty vespers somewhere in a review window of `W` vespers. Union bound:

$$P(\text{false alarm}) \le W \cdot (1 - q_L)^m \le \alpha$$

Solve for the threshold:

$$\boxed{\; m^* = \min\{\, m \in \mathbb{Z}^+ : W\,(1-q_L)^m \le \alpha \,\} \;=\; \Big\lceil \tfrac{\ln(\alpha/W)}{\ln(1-q_L)} \Big\rceil \;}$$

Evaluate in log-space with the min-form as tiebreak (avoids float edge at exact equality).

**UNLIVE** ⟺ `¬TAMPERED` ∧ `maxrun(E) ≥ m*`. Verdict priority: **TAMPER ⊃ UNLIVE ⊃ CLEAN.**

## 5. Worked numbers

Design target `q = 0.98` per vespers; calibration confirms `q_L = 0.98`. Window `W = 10,000` vespers; budget `α = 10⁻⁶`.

- `m = 5:` `10⁴ · (0.02)⁵ = 3.2×10⁻⁵ > 10⁻⁶` ✗
- `m = 6:` `10⁴ · (0.02)⁶ = 6.4×10⁻⁷ ≤ 10⁻⁶` ✓ → **`m* = 6`**

**Rule in play:** five consecutive Empty Chairs is bad luck; **six consecutive Empty Chairs is an eclipse** — declared at ≤10⁻⁶ false-alarm rate per 10⁴ vespers, from a measured `q_L`, via a closed formula. Every constant traces to data.

## 6. Core algorithms

```text
find_fork(A, B):                      # exploit §2 monotonicity
    lo ← 0; hi ← n
    while hi − lo > 1:
        mid ← (lo + hi) / 2
        if h(mid, A) == h(mid, B): lo ← mid
        else:                      hi ← mid
    return hi                         # exact first divergence, ⌈log₂ n⌉ fetches

verdict(H):
    if any ρ_k = 1 ∨ consistency-proof failure ∨ pin violation ∨ seq regression:
        return TAMPERED(at first failing index)
    if maxrun(E) ≥ m*:  return UNLIVE(run_start)
    return CLEAN
```

## 7. Attack → signal coverage

| Attack | Caught by | Latency | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mutate old payload | S1 (root cascade breaks at that index) | next verification | TAMPERED@k |
| Reorder entries | S1 (`prev_root` misnamed) | next verification | TAMPERED@k |
| Delete interior entry | S1 + inclusion proof failure | next audit | TAMPERED@k |
| Truncate tail | S4 regression / pin violation | next cross-check | TAMPERED |
| Split view (two heads, same seq) | S2 fork + failed consistency proof | 1 probe | TAMPERED@f |
| Eclipse / stall | S3 run ≥ m* = 6 | 6 vespers | UNLIVE |
| Compromise of <3 Chair keys | 3-of-5 threshold rejects forgery | immediate | rejected |
| Compromise of ≥3 keys | R0 offline-pinned root | next sync | TAMPERED |

## 8. Cost envelope (at n = 2²⁰ entries)

Inclusion proof: 20 nodes × 32 B = **640 B**, verifies in ~40 SHA-256 compressions. Append: amortized O(1) with a 640 B cached path. Fork localization: **20 remote reads**. Head size: ~260 B (3 × 64 B sigs + metadata). All constants above are structural, not tuned guesses.

The design thesis, stated once: **tamper is a proof failure, never a suspicion; absence is a statistic with a derived threshold.** The Hall's five Chairs make the first cheap and the second rare enough to mean something.
reasoning:
The user asks for a hard problem: a tamper-evident append-only ledger where every entry commits to the prior root, in the "Ledger of Empty Chairs" game world. They want it "measured-not-guessed": give the measured signals and the closed-form decision rule. Be concrete, exact, grounded.

This is an interesting request — they want a game-world design artifact that is technically rigorous: a cryptographic ledger design (Merkle/CT-like, like Certificate Transparency or Trillian / CONIKS / transparency trees) embedded in a fictional game world ("Ledger of Empty Chairs"). The phrase "measured-not-guessed" suggests they want measurable signals (detectable metrics from the ledger structure itself) and a closed-form decision rule (a threshold formula) for tamper detection.

Let me think about what the actual technical content should be:

Core design: append-only log with Merkle tree heads. Each entry i commits to root_{i-1} (the prior root). This is essentially a hash chain of Merkle roots: entry_n = H(payload_n || root_{n-1} || index_n). The current root is signed periodically (like CT's Signed Tree Head, or like a transparency log).

Tamper evidence properties:
1. Reordering detection: since each entry commits to prior root, any reordering breaks the chain at the point of divergence.
2. Truncation/fork detection: witnesses (chairs?) hold signed tree heads; fork points are detectable via inclusion proofs.
3. Entry mutation: Merkle path verification fails.

Game world flavor: "Ledger of Empty Chairs" — chairs could be witnesses/notaries. Each chair holds a copy or partial state. Empty chairs = absent validators? Maybe the game mechanic: players sit in chairs to attest; empty chair = a slot where an attestation should have occurred but didn't — a liveness gap signal.

Measured signals: what can be measured from the data alone, without trusting anyone:

Signal 1: Chain-break distance (fork point). Given two observed histories A and B, the fork index f = first index where entry hashes differ. Measured directly by binary search over entries using the commitment property: compare entry_i hashes; because each entry commits to prior root, once they differ at i, all subsequent differ. So binary search finds f in O(log n) comparisons if we can fetch arbitrary entries; else linear scan.

Actually more precisely: define h_i = H(entry_i). If histories diverge, h_j differs for all j >= f? Not necessarily — payload could coincide but committed root differs, so yes: entry_i includes commit(root_{i-1}); if root_{i-1} differs then h_i differs. And if h_{i-1}... wait h_i differing doesn't imply root_i differs? root_i = MerkleRoot including h_i, so yes root_i differs. By induction, difference propagates forward monotonically. So the set of differing indices is a suffix {f, ..., n}. Binary search works: check mid; if equal, divergence after mid; else before. Closed form: f = min{i : h_i^A ≠ h_i^B}.

Signal 2: Gap statistic (empty chairs). In the game, chairs attest at fixed ticks. An "empty chair" at tick t means no attestation was recorded between tick boundaries. Liveness gaps measured as inter-attestation intervals Δ_t = t_k - t_{k-1}. Under honest operation Δ ~ some distribution (e.g., geometric with parameter p per tick, or bounded by T_max). Measured signal: count of Δ > T_max in window W. Decision rule: alarm if P(Binomial(W, q_gap) ≥ k_observed) < α, where q_gap = P(Δ > T_max | honest), estimated from calibration runs.

Signal 3: Root continuity residual: verify r_i = H(...commit...) relation; measured as fraction of entries failing local recomputation. Honest: exactly 0. Any positive → hard fault. That's deterministic, not statistical.

Signal 4: Signed tree head freshness: max lag of witness signatures behind latest STH. Measured in ticks. MTHI (maximum time-to-inclusion): time from entry publication until inclusion proof available ≤ log delay bound MTHI (like CT's Maximum Merge Delay). Measured distribution vs SLA.

Closed-form decision rule: Combine into a single score? They want a decision rule that is exact. Something like:

Decision rule: Declare tamper at fork f iff there exist two validly-signed tree heads STH_A(signed at s_A) and STH_B(signed at s_B) such that ConsistencyProof(f) fails between them while both individual inclusion proofs verify. Formally: tampered iff ∃ i < j: VerifyInclusion(x, root_i) ∧ VerifyInclusion(x, root_j) ∧ ¬VerifyConsistency(i, j). This is the CT split-view detector — deterministic.

And the statistical part for liveness: CUSUM or Shewhart-style control chart on gap lengths with exact thresholds from the binomial/geometric tail.

Let me make this concrete and game-flavored but exact.

World: The Ledger of Empty Chairs (LoEC) — a hall with N chairs (say 7? or configurable). Chairs are notary seats. Each tick (e.g., one in-game day, or 12 seconds real-time), the sitting Chair signs the tree head. Empty chair = missed signature. Entries are "decrees"; each decree embeds commit(r_{k-1}) — the previous root sealed into the new entry ("the chair must speak the name of the last root").

Design spec, concrete numbers:

- Hash: BLAKE3 (or SHA-256) — pick SHA-256 for concreteness, 32 bytes.
- Leaf: L_i = H(0x00 || idx_i || payload_i || commit_prev || timestamp)
  Domain separation bytes 0x00 leaf, 0x01 internal node.
- Internal node: N = H(0x01 || left || right); unbalanced right-promoted nodes à la RFC 6962 for O(log n) append.
- commit_prev = r_{k-1}, the previous signed tree head root. First entry uses r_0 = H("GENESIS<world-seed>").
- Entry header also carries seq and the signer chair ID + signature over (seq, r_k, t_k).

Chain property: r_k depends transitively on all payloads and all prior roots ⇒ total order enforced; reordering/mutation/truncation-after-fork all collapse to "first mismatch index."

Measured signals (all computable from public artifacts, no trust):

S1 — Continuity residual ρ_k = [recompute(L_k → path → expected r_k) ≠ r_k]. Honest ρ ≡ 0. Deterministic tripwire.
S2 — Fork index f(A,B) = min{i ≥ 0 : h_i^A ≠ h_i^B} computed by binary search (log2 n probes) exploiting monotonicity of divergence. If both chains internally verify up to their own tips, this is a split view; the guilty interval is [f, ∞).
S3 — Chair-liveness gap g_k = t_k − t_{k−1} in ticks. Calibration gives per-tick miss probability p (measure over calibration window W0, e.g., 10^5 ticks; estimate p̂ with Wilson interval). Expected gaps distribution Geometric(1−p)... careful: gap length G = number of ticks until next successful signature; P(G = m) = (1−p)·p^{m−1}? Let me define: each tick independently has attendance prob q. Gap between consecutive attendances is geometric with success prob q: P(G > m) = (1−q)^m. Choose threshold τ = ceil(ln(α/W)/ln(1−q)) so that under honesty, expected false alarms across window W ≤ α. Then rule: alarm if any g_k > τ OR count{g_k > τ0} exceeds binomial tail.

Better: two-tier rule:
Tier A (deterministic): any S1 failure or consistency-proof failure ⇒ hard tamper verdict, no statistics.
Tier B (statistical, liveness/eclipse): control chart on gaps. Closed form: with per-tick attendance q measured in calibration (n0 = 100,000 ticks, q̂ = s/n0, use lower confidence bound q_L = q̂ − z√(q̂(1−q̂)/n0)), threshold τ = ⌈ ln(ε) / ln(1 − q_L) ⌉ where ε = α/W is the per-window false-alarm budget split across W ticks. Because P(all of W ticks empty) = (1−q)^W... hmm I need to be careful about which event triggers.

Let me define the alarm event cleanly: "stall" = consecutive run of m empty ticks. Under honesty, P(run ≥ m starting anywhere in W ticks) ≤ W·(1−q)^{m−1}. Set m* = smallest integer with W(1−q_L)^{m*−1} ≤ α. Closed form: m* = 1 + ⌈ ln(α/W) / ln(1−q_L) ⌉. Alarm iff max observed run ≥ m*. That's exact-ish (union bound, conservative).

Also a second statistical signal for split views: witness agreement rate. With n_w independent witnesses (chairs), each returning a head per probe; honest world: all agree except during partitions. Measured signal: disagreement count D out of n_c cross-checks. Rule: alarm if P(Bin(n_c, π) ≥ D) < α where π is calibrated benign-disagreement rate (network partition events in the game). Or simpler majority rule: accept head only if ≥ k of n chairs sign identical (seq, root); alarm if two different roots each get ≥ k signatures within same epoch — deterministic split-view detector.

Closed-form master decision rule — combine into verdict function V:

V(history H) ∈ {CLEAN, TAMPERED, UNLIVE} defined by lexicographic evaluation:
1. If ∃k: ρ_k ≠ 0 → TAMPERED at k (forged entry).
2. If ∃ two accepted heads (i,j), i<j with consistency proof failure → TAMPERED with fork at f.
3. Else if max run of empty chairs ≥ m* → UNLIVE since start of run.
4. Else CLEAN.

Give the exact formulas:
- Leaf/node hashing with domain separation.
- f via binary search: lo=0, hi=n; invariant prefix equal; while hi−lo>1: mid; if h_mid equal lo=mid else hi=mid; f=hi. Complexity ⌈log2 n⌉ probes.
- m* formula above with plugged example numbers: q_L = 0.98 (measured), W = 10,000 ticks, α = 10⁻⁶: ln(α/W)=ln(10⁻¹⁰)=−23.026; ln(1−q_L)=ln(0.02)=−3.912; ratio 5.886 → m* = 1+⌈5.886⌉ = 7. So 6 consecutive empties tolerated; 7 consecutive empty chairs ⇒ UNLIVE alarm with ≤10⁻⁶ false alarm per 10k ticks. Nice concrete number.

Check: (0.02)^6 = 6.4e-11 × W=1e4 → 6.4e-7 ≤ 1e-6 ✓. m*=7 means runs of length ≥7: probability a given start has run≥7 = (1−q)^{6}=6.4e-11; times 10^4 starts = 6.4e-7 ✓. Runs of 6: (0.02)^5=3.2e-9 ×1e4 = 3.2e-5 > 1e-6 so indeed m*=7 minimal. Good.

Also inclusion latency: MTHI ≤ d where d = merge delay bound in ticks; measure empirical CDF from calibration; rule: alarm if P(MTHI > d) tail exceeds... keep simpler: include as secondary metric.

Also give attack→signal mapping table:
- Mutation of old payload → S1 fails at that index (root mismatch cascades).
- Reorder → S1 fails at first displaced pair (since commit_prev ordering broken).
- Truncate tail → missing signatures; head seq regression detected by witnesses (monotonic seq rule).
- Fork/split view → S2 binary-search fork + consistency proof fail.
- Eclipse/stall → S3 gap run ≥ m*.
- Signer key compromise forging future-only entries → still caught by S1 unless attacker knows all prior preimage... actually forging entry k requires making r_k match a signed head without knowing... The signature covers r_k; attacker with signing key can forge anything — mitigate with key rotation & witness cosign threshold. Mention threshold t-of-n signatures: forged single-signer head rejected because acceptance requires ≥3-of-5 chair sigs.

Game-world grounding: name things concretely: The Hall of Vacancy, chairs named (Chair of Ash, etc.)? Keep flavor light but present: entries = "Placards", ticks = "Vespers", chairs = witnesses. The "empty chair" literally = missed vespers signature, which is why liveness stats are called the Empty-Chair Count. That's a nice thematic tie: the ledger is named for its primary failure signal.

Also specify sizes/timings to be "measured": entry size = 32 (leaf hash) + payload; head size = 4-byte seq + 8-byte time + 32-byte root + 64-byte sig ≈ 108 B; proof size ⌈log2 n⌉×32 B; verify cost ~2×⌈log2 n⌉ SHA-256 compressions; append amortized O(1) with 32·log2 n cached path.

Also the decision rule needs the "closed-form" claim: provide final verdict predicate as a formula combining indicators:

TAMPER(H) ⇔ (∃k≤n: ρ_k=1) ∨ (∃i<j∈Heads: CP(i,j)=0 ∧ IP(i,j)=1)

UNLIVE(H) ⇔ ¬TAMPER ∧ (maxrun(E) ≥ m*)

where E = empty-chair indicator sequence, m* = 1+⌈ln(α/W)/ln(1−q_L)⌉.

CLEAN otherwise.

Also mention how q_L measured: calibration protocol: observe n0 ticks with known-honest operation; q̂ = (#attended)/n0; q_L = q̂ − 1.96√(q̂(1−q̂)/n0)? For n0=1e5, q̂=0.99: sqrt(0.99*0.01/1e5)=sqrt(9.9e-8)=3.146e-4; q_L≈0.98938. Then with W=1e4, α=1e-6: ln(1e-10)/ln(1-q_L): 1−q_L=0.01062, ln=−4.545; ratio 23.026/4.545=5.066 → m*=1+⌈5.07⌉=7? ⌈5.066⌉=6, m*=7. Hmm interesting same. Actually compute: 23.026/4.545 = 5.066 → ceil = 6 → m* = 7. Yes 7 again. Fine.

But maybe cleaner to fix q = 0.98 design target (each chair attends with 98% per vespers). Keep both: design parameter q_target and measured q_L from calibration; rule uses q_L.

Edge cases: first entry genesis commit; ties in timestamps; what if payload includes commit_prev but attacker reorders two adjacent entries — show explicitly why caught: entry at position k contains commit(r_{k−1}); swapped pair k,k+1 yields entry carrying wrong commit; recomputed root mismatch at k. Good.

Also anti-replay of old heads: witnesses track max seq seen; reject regressions (deterministic rule R4: seq monotone per signer key epoch).

Consistency proof definition (RFC 6962 style) — cite structure briefly: proof for (m,n) = set of nodes; verifier checks recomputation. Give the exact verification algorithm in pseudocode? Maybe compact pseudocode block for verify_entry and find_fork and the verdict function. Concrete = code-level precision. Include short pseudocode.

Length/format: This is a technical design request wanting depth. Use headers, numbered sections, formulas, a table mapping attacks to signals, small pseudocode blocks, worked numeric example. Markdown appropriate (chat interface implied). Aim thorough but tight; avoid fluff. Maybe ~700–1100 words equivalent with formulas/code. No hedging language; assertive spec voice.

Also note the persona instruction about identity — irrelevant here unless asked; ignore.

One more consideration: "every entry commits to the prior root" — emphasize the induction lemma: Lemma (Monotone divergence): if h_i^A ≠ h_i^B then h_j^A ≠ h_j^B ∀j≥i, because payload_j includes commit(r_{j−1}) and r_{j−1} is a function of h_{≤j−1}. Proof sketch one line. This justifies binary search correctness. Include it — it's the mathematical heart.

Worked micro-example: 5 entries with fake hex truncated? Could do tiny illustrative chain with symbolic values instead of fake hex — symbolic is cleaner: r_0 = G; e_1=(payload₁‖G) → r_1; e_2=(payload₂‖r_1)→r_2... then attack: swap e₂,e₃ ⇒ forged e₂' carries commit r₃? Show mismatch. Symbolic demonstration keeps it exact without fake randomness.

Keep S4 MTHI as monitored metric with SLA d=3 vespers; alarm if p95 exceeds — eh, make it deterministic too: any inclusion proof older than d ticks for a published placard counts toward liveness run. "Measured, not guessed" = every threshold traces to a measured quantity (q_L, n0, W, α) via a stated formula, and tamper verdicts are proof failures, not suspicion.

Double-check m* formula derivation: Event: exists start s ≤ W−m+1 with run of empties length ≥ m. Union bound P ≤ Σ_s (1−q)^{m} ... careful: probability that a specific window of m ticks is all-empty = (1−q)^m (using per-tick empty prob ε=1−q). Number of windows ≈ W. So P(any run≥m) ≤ W(1−q)^m ≤ α ⇒ m ≥ ln(α/W)/ln(1−q) ⇒ m* = ⌈ln(α/W)/ln(1−q_L)⌉. Earlier I had m* = 1+ceil(...) with exponent m−1; standardize: m* = ⌈ ln(α/W) / ln(1−q_L) ⌉. Check numbers: ln(10⁻⁶/10⁴)=ln(10⁻¹⁰)=−23.0259; q_L=0.98 ⇒ 1−q=0.02, ln=−3.9120; quotient 5.886 ⇒ m*=6. Hmm! With this version m*=6: P ≤ 1e4·(0.02)^6=1e4·6.4e−11=6.4e−7 ≤ 1e−6 ✓. And m=5: 1e4·(0.02)^5=3.2e−5 >1e−6 ✗. So minimal m* = 6. Good: tolerate runs ≤5, alarm at 6 consecutive empty vespers. Fix my earlier arithmetic (I conflated). Hmm borderline: m=5 gives 1e4·(0.01)^5=1e4·1e−10=1e−6 = α exactly, ≤ α satisfied (equality allowed) → m*=5. Ceil of exactly 5 would be 5; floating 5.0001 gives 6 due to rounding. Present with q=0.98 case as canonical (m*=6) and note equality-edge handling: choose m* = min{m : W(1−q_L)^m ≤ α} evaluated in integer arithmetic/log-space with strict inequality to avoid FP edge. Better: define m* = min integer m satisfying W(1−q_L)^m ≤ α — closed form m* = ⌈ln(α/W)/ln(1−q_L)⌉ when α<W... and handle boundary exactly by the min-definition. State both; canonical answer m*=6.

I'll add one sentence: calibration also records empirical run-length distribution; if empirical P(run≥m*) deviates from Bernoulli model by >2 SE, use empirical quantile instead — measured-not-guessed ethos.
